frozen_question: Will the Central Bank of Colombia make no change to the monetary policy interest rate at the October meeting?
facts: The live official calendar page captured Oct 19 includes the October 2026 Board meeting titled “Reunión de la Junta Directiva de octubre de 2026 - Decisión sobre la tasa de interés de intervención,” with start 2026-10-30 08:30 and end 13:00 in embedded calendar data. The time-zone field was not shown in the captured event record.

The same calendar page lists the Sept 30, 2026 Board decision as increasing the monetary-policy rate by 25 bp to 12.25%, effective Oct 1; minutes are listed as published Oct 5. The linked detailed September page returned an anti-bot challenge (HTTP 200 body), so its body did not independently load.

The frozen resolution is strictly the official October-meeting change versus the pre-meeting upper bound when a band is used; emergency changes outside the specified meeting do not count. The exact market supplies the Oct 30 date and official calendar URL.
gaps: No October decision or outcome exists as of capture; the specified meeting is future.
Static captured calendar provides no explicit timezone for 08:30–13:00.
Linked September detail body inaccessible behind bot challenge; calendar listing provides the dated rate figure but not full decision rationale.
